Design review: a set applies the first matching rule in list order, so rule order is verified as sent while conditions compare as sets; a dimension change restates the rules, because the set rules cannot be read after the set in the same review.
limitations: Synthetic validation only; no live provider credentials, reads or account mutations in this batch.
The GAQL field lists were extracted from the public field reference pages, not a live query.
Whether a rule already belongs to another active set is enforced by Google (DATA_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION), not read in review.
SET actions, itinerary conditions, store-visit categories and NO_CONDITION sets stay unqualified.
